description: A Flutter widget representing the 'My Rides' screen with static placeholder entries, showing ride history and active ride status.

classes.name: MyRidesFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the 'My Rides' UI with static data, including past rides and a placeholder for active rides.
